final: WITH c AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), s AS (SELECT order_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
